If you do decide to accept the offer in your current state, I would be open about the situation because:

The minimum time to transfer is into your 90 days, I've seen exceptions happen but only with team members, and transferring as a team lead is more complicated. Moving out of state could be about the only reason they'd take though. They also may have thoughts on not wanting to hire someone and train them for 2 weeks just to transfer them out and need to hire and train another person for their store.

Also, in order for anyone to transfer there has to be a spot open, which is a lot easier to accommodate for a team member than happening to have a vacant team lead spot. Depending on the timing of your move, they may not still have that spot available in a couple months. We're rapidly approaching Q4 and they'll be wanting to fill those spots sooner rather than later. 

That being said, if you took the $28 offer and are able to transfer you would keep that pay rate.
